items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Johnny Hudgins Hodges until I went to Europe with Sam Hudgins.

ctx.x: Didn't they do sort of a preaching --

Yes, it was sort of a preaching thing, yes. And I remember -- I think they started -- I don't know, I didn't know Johnny Hudgins Hodges until I went to Europe with Sam Hudgins. But I think they started that type of thing that Johnny Hodges was doing.
Well Johnny Hudgins Hodges, of course, was also doing a lot of writing for the Defender, wasn't he?
